widget_spec.title: Beszel Homelab Monitor
widget_spec.description: Direct homelab monitoring widget using Beszel Hub API with Catppuccin Mocha aesthetic
widget_spec.author: Nerver-zip & Antigravity

globals.name: sys_idx
globals.description: Index of active system in sys_json

globals.name: sys_id
globals.description: PocketBase record ID of active system

globals.name: metric
globals.description: Active chart metric (cpu, mem, disk, net)

globals.name: last_code
globals.description: HTTP status code of last response

children.name: StatusIndicator
children.color: $if(gv(stale) = 1, gv(c_warn), if(wg(gv(sys_json), json, '.items[' + gv(sys_idx) + '].status') = 'up', gv(c_ok), gv(c_err)))$

children.name: Fill
children.color: $if(wg(gv(sys_json), json, '.items[' + gv(sys_idx) + '].info.cpu') >= 95, gv(c_err), if(wg(gv(sys_json), json, '.items[' + gv(sys_idx) + '].info.cpu') >= 85, gv(c_peach), if(wg(gv(sys_json), json, '.items[' + gv(sys_idx) + '].info.cpu') >= 70, gv(c_warn), gv(c_cpu))))$

children.name: Fill
children.color: $if(wg(gv(sys_json), json, '.items[' + gv(sys_idx) + '].info.mp') >= 95, gv(c_err), if(wg(gv(sys_json), json, '.items[' + gv(sys_idx) + '].info.mp') >= 85, gv(c_peach), if(wg(gv(sys_json), json, '.items[' + gv(sys_idx) + '].info.mp') >= 70, gv(c_warn), gv(c_ram))))$

children.name: Fill
children.color: $if(wg(gv(sys_json), json, '.items[' + gv(sys_idx) + '].info.dp') >= 95, gv(c_err), if(wg(gv(sys_json), json, '.items[' + gv(sys_idx) + '].info.dp') >= 85, gv(c_peach), if(wg(gv(sys_json), json, '.items[' + gv(sys_idx) + '].info.dp') >= 70, gv(c_warn), gv(c_disk))))$

children.name: NetStats
children.text: ↓$mu(round, wg(gv(sys_json), json, '.items[' + gv(sys_idx) + '].info.bb[1]') / 1024)$K ↑$mu(round, wg(gv(sys_json), json, '.items[' + gv(sys_idx) + '].info.bb[0]') / 1024)$K

children.name: RAM
children.text: $if(wg(gv(cnt_json), json, '.stats[' + (gv(container_page) * 5 + 0) + '].m') < 1073741824, mu(round, wg(gv(cnt_json), json, '.stats[' + (gv(container_page) * 5 + 0) + '].m') / 1048576) + ' MiB', mu(round, wg(gv(cnt_json), json, '.stats[' + (gv(container_page) * 5 + 0) + '].m') / 1073741824, 1) + ' GiB')$
